geometry.anchor: Objects: barycentric anchors in face vertex order. Arrays: [ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,nx,ny,nz], one source side; mirror x and nx.
geometry.coordinates: Reference mesh coordinates; no offset baked in.
geometry.continuity: Triangle guides are independent. Model chains follow verified source-edge adjacency; signed local index -i-1 reverses endpoints without changing the normal. Never bridge a gap or culled edge.
geometry.layer: Independent source guides reveal through covering anatomy; normals hide their own far-facing surfaces.

provenance.origin: BoGa procedural surface fields plus registered BodyParts3D source shapes; see anatomy for source checksums, license and adaptations.
provenance.literatureUse: Literature informs qualitative directions only; no publication figures or measured fascicle directions copied. Licensed BodyParts3D geometry informs full muscle shape.
